doc: -- | The PSX backend for Halogen. Lowered `.psx` code calls it through the
-- | The core is hand-written in `Halogen.Psx.Core`. The elements and
-- | properties below keep Halogen's typed rows: an element Halogen defines is
-- | Halogen's own (`HH.button`), and a property Halogen types is typed by its
-- | row, so Halogen still rejects `<button viewBox="...">`. Everything else
-- | is an untyped attribute, property or handler, as in `HH.element`.
-- | Halogen's leaf elements (`textarea`, `canvas`, `iframe`) take no children.
imports: Halogen.Psx.Core (class Content, Attr, Node, attribute, elementOf, keyedHtmlElement, keyedSvgElement, onValueInput, svgNamespace)

childHoles :: forall w a. B.Node w a -> B.Markup w a
